items.observation: textScaleFactor is marked 'Will be removed in 2.0.0.'. Two ignores and text_scale_factor_test depend on this parameter.
items.proposed_fix: In 2.0.0 remove the parameter, these two ignores and text_scale_factor_test; write a migration note in the CHANGELOG. The ignore at :946 depends on the Flutter TextScaler.textScaleFactor and stays separate.
items.closure_criteria: The 2.0.0 release removes the textScaleFactor parameter, its two ignores and text_scale_factor_test, and the CHANGELOG carries a migration note. The ignore for the Flutter TextScaler override at line 946 stays untouched.

items.observation: The degenerate base check (`!isFinite || <= 0`) is hand repeated in two places.
items.proposed_fix: Write a single private helper function; let both call sites use it.
items.closure_criteria: One private helper holds the degenerate base check and both call sites use it.

items.observation: _calculateFontSize spans 105 lines: style resolution, preset and step branches, and binary search in one function. The search is a pure operation yet cannot be tested separately.
items.proposed_fix: Extract the binary search over the candidate list into a pure function that takes the fit check as a callback. Widget tests act as the safety net; add unit tests for boundary cases.
items.closure_criteria: The binary search over candidate sizes is a pure function taking the fit check as a callback, with unit tests for boundary cases. The widget tests keep passing.

items.observation: When wrapWords is false a new RegExp (whitespace splitter) is created on every probe.
items.proposed_fix: Move the RegExp into a static final field.
items.closure_criteria: The whitespace splitter RegExp lives in a static final field and no RegExp is allocated per probe.

items.observation: The example declares flutter >=3.22.0 while the package requires >=3.32.0. The sdk ^3.8.0 constraint of the example also disagrees with the 3.22 base.
items.proposed_fix: Align the example flutter base to 3.32.0.
items.closure_criteria: example/pubspec.yaml declares flutter >=3.32.0 and an sdk constraint consistent with the package floor.
